nodes.label: Graphify Workflow
nodes.rationale: Use the graph for codebase questions and update it after code changes.

nodes.label: Backup and Restore
nodes.rationale: Production restoration must be tested separately and inventory, sales totals, and credit balances checked before restoring production.

nodes.label: Release Procedure
nodes.rationale: A release requires source checks, ordered migrations, Edge Function deployment, GitHub Pages verification, and live administrator, staff, inventory, sale, credit, and transfer tests.

nodes.label: FIFO Selling Price Batches
nodes.rationale: The oldest available batch price determines catalog pricing, mixed-batch sales retain their exact price breakdown, and completed sales preserve that breakdown.
